Package io.github.janglada.orkit

Interface CpSatProblem<S extends Solution>

All Superinterfaces:
OptimizationProblem<S>
All Known Implementing Classes:
BookingBuilder, CuttingBuilder, JobShopBuilder, MultipleKnapsackBuilder, PackingBuilder, SchedulingBuilder
public interface CpSatProblem<S extends Solution> extends OptimizationProblem<S>
A built, immutable CP-SAT problem that yields a CpSatSolver (not just a generic Solver) so that workers, seed, callbacks, and warm starts are available without a cast.
